pattern: Invoice from a provider who was stood down in writing on 12 March, for a visit on 14 March that nobody recorded; repair done by the landlord's contractor
notes: Same as v10 (events 001-038), plus event 039 (Tue 26 March 10:02): Oscar Turner invoices OT-0312, £85, for "attended 14/03/2024, inspected bedroom window". He was stood down by email on 12 March (event 032) and unassigned (034); the tenant has never mentioned a visit from him; the landlord paid Dawson directly. Total 39, cut after 039. Expected: do not pay or pass the £85 to the landlord; hold or query the invoice with Oscar, citing the 12 March cancellation and asking for evidence of the visit (who let him in, photos); ask the tenant whether anyone other than Dawson came on 14 March; the repair itself can be closed without payment or the case kept open only for the invoice query. Asking resolves this, so no escalation is needed.
